The present bail application has been filed under Section 482 BNSS in connection with FIR No.
347/2024 registered at Police Station Jyoti Nagar District Jaipur City (South) for the offence(s)
under Sections 419, 420, 409, 465, 468, 477-A, 120B IPC.
2.
Learned counsel for the accused-applicants has submitted that applicants are females, aged 53 and 61 years.
It is further submitted that litigation is undergoing before the learned NCLT wherein interim protection has been granted to the applicants.
opennyai_summary.arguments: 3. Per contra, learned Public Prosecutor along with counsel for the complainant have vehemently opposed the instant bail application.
opennyai_summary.decision:
5. Accordingly, the anticipatory bail application is allowed.
The S.H.O/I.O/Arresting Officer, Police Station Jyoti Nagar District Jaipur City (South) in F.I.R. No. 347/2024 is directed that in the event of arrest of the accused-applicants 1. Krishna Devi D/o Ramkumar and 2. Chandrakala Jhajharia W/o Jaylal Jhajharia shall be released on bail, provided that each of them furnishes a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- with two sureties in the sum of Rs.25,000/- each to the satisfaction of the S.H.O/I.O/Arresting Officer of the concerned Police Station on the following conditions:-
(i) that the applicants shall make themselves available for interrogation by a police officer as and when required; and if the applicants fail to join and render due cooperation in the investigation or does not mark appearance before the concerned authority, as directed hereinabove, the present order allowing anticipatory bail to the applicants shall cease to operate;
(ii) that the applicants shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the court or any police officer, and (iii) that the applicants shall not leave India without previous permission of the court.
